description: PowerSimData, published by breakthrough-energy, manages power-system datasets and scenarios, investment studies and calls to external power-flow simulation engines. Coverage: The documented project studies the US grid; model geography and time resolution depend on the selected scenario inputs. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Only a subset of functions is available from the Python package alone; complex scenarios require external solvers. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
